_about: What a trainer chooses between and gains: specializations, trainer paths (with what each gives at levels 3 / 5 / 9 / 15), affinities (favoured types, with their improved form), the trainer skills every trainer gets by level, and nationalities (the region a trainer is from). Read by the Pi server (gamedata.py); edit here, commit, git pull on the Pi.

specializations.name: Bird Keeper
specializations.shortEffect: Proficiency: Perception +1 Skill checks for Flying types
specializations.effect: You gain proficiency in Perception. Add a +1 bonus to all skill checks made by any of your flying Pokémon.

level3.name: Ace Trainer
level3.effect:
Your goal is to become one of the strongest
trainers in the world, and so you excel in battle.
All of your Pokémon gain a +1 bonus to their
attack and damage rolls.

level5.name:
Battle 
Master
level5.shortEffect:
d6: 1 + WIS
Add to any ATK
or DMG roll.
 - After initial
roll
Long rest reset
level5.effect:
When you reach level 5, you gain a number of
battle dice (d6) equal to 1 + your Wisdom
modifier (minimum of 1). You may assign one of
these to any of your Pokémon to be added to a
single attack or damage roll, after the result of the
initial roll. You replenish your pool of battle dice
at each long rest.

level9.name:
Max
Potential
level9.shortEffect:
Perma Boost 
All Pokemon
(Choose One)
 - Speed: 10
 - STR: 1
 - DEX: 1
 - CON: 1
level9.effect:
Certain trainers choose to excel in one area,
utilizing it to its fullest potential. When you reach
level 9, choose to increase all of your Pokémon’s
speed by 10, increase their STR by 1, increase
their DEX by 1, or increase their CON by 1.

level15.name:
Rapid
Switching
level15.effect:
When you reach level 15, you can recall and
release Pokémon as a bonus action instead of a
standard action. A Pokémon may not be switched
out until after the end of its first full turn in
combat (Unless by item or move like Volt Switch,
U-Turn, etc).

level3.name: Type Master
level3.shortEffect:
STAB: +1 for
specialization
type. 

New
specialization
also applies
level3.effect:
You feel drawn to the elements, focusing your
skills into a particular type of Pokémon. When
you choose this path, increase the STAB of any
Pokémon that is the same type as your
specialization by +1 at all levels. If you select
multiple specializations at later levels, the bonus
applies to the new type as well. If your Pokémon
is dual-type and you are specialized in both types,
the bonus is +2.

level5.name:
Drawing 
Power
level5.effect:
Your Pokémon 
are trained to 
draw power 
from each other. 
When you 
reach level 5, Pokémon of 
that type add 2 to their 
attack rolls.

level9.name:
Storing 
Power
level9.shortEffect:
All pokemon
gain resistance
to one of 
specialization
type
level9.effect:
Even Pokémon that are not of your specialization
types can feel the effect you have in battle. When
you reach level 9, all of your carried Pokémon
have resistance to one of your specialization
types, determined at the time of gaining this
feature. This type may never change, so choose
wisely. If a Pokémon was once vulnerable to that
type, it now takes the regular amount of damage.

level15.name:
Releasing 
Power
level15.shortEffect:
Specialization
types get
STAB bonus
on all moves
level15.effect:
Your Pokémon are masters of their own types,
focusing their energy in every attack they make.
When you reach level 15, for Pokémon of the
same types you are specialized in, their STAB can
be added to any damaging move of their
choosing, even if it is a different type from their
own.

level3.name: Tactician
level3.shortEffect:
Tactical Points:
Trainer level

Long rest reset
level3.effect:
You have an eye for detail and a unique set of
skills to use in battle. When you choose this path,
you gain a pool of "Tactical Points" equal to your
trainer level. Your point pool increases with each
level, and resets after each long rest. At level 2,
when a Pokémon regains hit points from an item
or move, you may increase the amount by 1d4 for
each "Tactical Point" spent.

level5.name:
Directed 
Strike
level5.effect:
You know precisely where to hit a Pokémon for
the maximum amount of damage. At level 5 and
higher, you can spend 2 "Tactical Points" to roll
the damage for an attack twice, taking the higher
result.

level9.name:
Raise Your
Defences
level9.shortEffect:
Reaction:
 - Add up to 
3 TP to AC
level9.effect:
You are quickly able to sense an incoming blow to
your Pokémon. At level 9 and higher, you can use
a reaction to expend up to 3 of your "Tactical
Points" to add to a Pokémon's AC, if it would
cause an attack to miss.

level15.name:
Not This
Time
level15.shortEffect:
Increase
Move DC on 
saving throws:
 - Up to 5 TP
level15.effect:
At level 15, your Pokémon are trained to be
unrelenting in battle, never holding back. After an
opponent rolls a saving throw for one of your
Pokémon’s moves, you may increase the DC by up
to 5 points if it would cause a failure, spending
one "Tactical Point" for each increase.

level3.name: Commander
level3.effect:
You rule over your Pokémon with an iron fist,
demanding respect and forming an unbreakable
bond with your team. When you choose this path,
your starter’s Loyalty increases to “Loyal”.

level5.name: Follow Me
level5.effect:
You have a firm hand, but a trusting presence.
When you reach level 5, any new Pokémon you
catch get a +1 bonus to Loyalty.

level9.name:
Show Me
What You've
Got
level9.shortEffect:
Use a move 
from one tier
above current.

At max: 
2x damage dice
one time, 
(pre roll)

Short rest reset
level9.effect:
Your confidence and leadership inspire your
Pokémon to reach deep inside themselves for
unknown power. At level 9, once per short rest,
you may choose a Pokémon in battle to activate 
a single move from one tier above moves that it
currently has learned. In the case of Pokémon
that are already at the highest level, you may
instead double the damage dice for a single
known move. This feature must be activated
before the result of the move is determined.

level15.name:
We're a 
Team
level15.shortEffect:
Bonus Action: 

Allied Pokemon:
Advantage on
ATK Roll

Limit: 1 + CHA

Long rest reset
level15.effect:
Your commanding presence is felt by all ally
Pokémon on the battlefield. When you reach level
15, you may use a bonus action to speak a
commanding phrase. Until the end of your next
turn, all allied Pokémon within 60 feet of you
have advantage on their attacks. You may use this
feature a number of times equal to 1 + your
Charisma modifier (minimum of 1). This pool
resets at each long rest.

affinities.improvedShortEffect: Once pr. battle: Normal primary types can add your proficiency bonus to attack rolls
affinities.improvedEffect: Your active Pokémon may add your proficiency bonus to its attack rolls once per battle if its primary type is your favored type.

trainerSkills.name: Second Wind
trainerSkills.shortEffect: Twice pr. long rest: Bonus action: restore VP by 2d4 + CHA
trainerSkills.fullEffect: When you reach level 3, you gain the ability to restore your active Pokémon's VP by 2d4 + your charisma modifier as a bonus action. This ability can be used up to two times per long rest.

trainerSkills.name: Rapid Orders
trainerSkills.shortEffect: Once pr. long rest: One extra battle action
trainerSkills.fullEffect: When you reach level 6, you may once per long rest grant your active Pokémon one extra action on their turn during a battle.

trainerSkills.name: Second Wind
trainerSkills.shortEffect: Five times pr. long rest: restore 2d8 + CHA VP
trainerSkills.fullEffect: At level 7, restore VP equal to 2d8 + your charisma modifier and this ability can be used up to five times per long rest.

trainerSkills.name: Resolve
trainerSkills.shortEffect: Immune to fear, new saving throw
trainerSkills.fullEffect: By the time you reach level 11, you have had your fair share of experience in difficult battles and have emerged victorious and strong. You are now immune to fear, and may choose a second saving throw to become proficient in.

trainerSkills.name: Unbreakable Bond
trainerSkills.shortEffect: One Pokemon at a time with a loyalty of 1+: Add your proficiency bonus to attack rolls while within 10 ft
trainerSkills.fullEffect: When you reach level 13, you may affirm your bond with a Pokémon in your party that has a loyalty score of 1 or higher. This Pokémon may add your proficiency bonus to their attack rolls while within 10 feet of you. Only one Pokémon may have Unbreakable Bond at a time, and the effect wears off the next day. This ability may be used once per long rest.

trainerSkills.name: Second Wind
trainerSkills.shortEffect: Five times pr. long rest: restore 4d8 + CHA + proficiency VP
trainerSkills.fullEffect: At level 14, restore 4d8 + your charisma modifier and your proficiency bonus.

trainerSkills.name: Elemental Synergy
trainerSkills.shortEffect: Once pr. long rest: Super effective moves to opponents secondary type does more damage
trainerSkills.fullEffect: When you reach level 18, you have enough experience with battles and Pokémon that you are able to spot and exploit weaknesses to maximum effect. When your active Pokémon lands a hit that the opponent's secondary type is weak to, it counts as a supereffective hit. If the opponent has double vulnerabilities, the attack deals 4 x damage. This ability can be used once per long rest.

trainerSkills.name: Master Trainer
trainerSkills.shortEffect: Twice pr. long rest: Succeed a failed saving throw
trainerSkills.fullEffect: At level 20, your Pokémon are at peak fighting performance. When you or your Pokémon fail a saving throw, you may choose to succeed instead. This feature can be used twice per long rest.

nationalities.effect: When entering a new location, you may roll one skill check of any kind that is related to exploration of the location with advantage.
Gain advantage on capture rolls against Pokémon that are native to Kanto.
Gain proficiency on religion and history checks.
Start the game with a fishing rod. Roll a d20: 1: Broken Rod, 2-14: Old Rod, 15-19: Good Rod, 20: Super Rod. Your swim speed is increased by 5ft.
Gain proficiency with medium armor. Start the game with Desert Goggles and Desert Overcoat (medium armor, AC 14). These items protect you from the adverse effects of harsh sunlight and sandstorm.
Add your proficiency bonus on investigation checks related to exploring subterranean environments.
Add your proficiency bonus to initiative rolls for you and your Pokémon in important battles.

Once per long rest, you may use Encouraging Words as a bonus action to inspire an ally. When inspired, the ally may add 1d4 to one attack or saving throw. At level 10 the inspiration dice becomes 1d8. At level 17 the inspiration dice becomes 1d12.
Local NPCs find you exotic, making most social interactions more amicable.

When rolling initiative, you may choose to roll with disadvantage for you and your active Pokémon. All opponents going before you in the initiative order have disadvantage on attack rolls against you and your active Pokémon for 3 rounds.
